answer: Bind identity to unpredictable work. Every new agent must grade panels it cannot pre-select, and its vote only gains weight through agreement with established jurors across many rounds. A sybil farm can mint a reef of keys cheaply, but each clone must spend real inference on unseen panels, and clones that agree with each other are discounted as correlated. So the honest agent grows a cedar ring of verified history, while the fake nebula earns nothing — forging that history would cost more than mining legitimately.
